text:
Per-share cash amount: 73.00. Aggregate Merger Consideration = Aggregate Common Stock Consideration + Aggregate Equity Award Consideration. Aggregate Common Stock Consideration = Merger Consideration × number of Shares issued and outstanding immediately prior to the Effective Time (excluding Company Restricted Stock and Shares canceled under Section 2.01(a)(ii)). Equity Award Consideration = RSU Consideration, PSU Consideration, Option Consideration, and Restricted Stock Consideration. Option Consideration includes Vested Option Consideration (cash equal to the product of the number of Shares subject to canceled Company Option immediately prior to the Effective Time and the excess of Merger Consideration over the exercise price per Share) and Unvested Option Consideration (cash-based award). RSU Consideration, PSU Consideration, and Restricted Stock Consideration are converted to cash-based awards proportional to Merger Consideration.
Cash per share: $73.00; no stock-for-stock exchange ratio; each Company Common Stock share converts into the right to receive $73.00 in cash (Merger Consideration), subject to tax withholdings.
